title: SAM 3.1 Video Segmentation
description: SAM 3.1 builds comes with Object Multiplex, a shared-memory approach for joint multi-object tracking that delivers faster speeds with larger number of objects tracked.

pricing.text: Your request will cost $0.01 per 16 frames of video input.

estimate.label: of video at 30 fps (60 fps footage costs double)

inputs.name: video
inputs.tooltip: The URL of the video to be segmented.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: Text prompt for segmentation. Use commas to track multiple objects (e.g., 'person, cloth'). Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: point_prompts
inputs.tooltip: List of point prompts JSON. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: box_prompts
inputs.tooltip: List of box prompt coordinates (x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max). JSON. Empty leaves it out.

inputs.name: apply_mask
inputs.tooltip: Apply the mask on the video.

inputs.name: video_output_type
inputs.tooltip: The output type of the generated video.

inputs.name: detection_threshold
inputs.tooltip: Detection confidence threshold (0.0-1.0). Lower = more detections but less precise.

inputs.name: max_num_objects
inputs.tooltip: Maximum number of objects to track in the video.
